# ATL13 v7 granule list for the Dnipro-Buh liman reference water body
# (refid 6033000138), including the Pivdenno-Buzkyi (Southern Bug) arm to
# Mykolaiv. Rebuilt 2026-09-04 by an independent CMR polygon search
# (sliderule.earthdata.cmr, short_name=ATL13, version=007) against
# data/aoi/dnipro_estuary.geojson -- the buffered convex hull of the
# operator's 17 landmark points, i.e. the exact clip this pipeline applies
# to the pass-level table. Any granule whose ground track crosses that
# polygon at all is included, regardless of the granule's own footprint
# size, so this list is complete for THIS analysis region.
#
# NOTE: the operator's original SlideRule web-client atl13x request
# enumerated ~1400 resources for a wider/earlier-drafted discovery area
# (this server's earthdata.cmr caps a single query at 300 CMR hits --
# confirmed by a >300 error on a wider box -- so the web client must have
# used a broader box and its own pagination/time-chunking to exceed that).
# 266 granules, 2018-10-17 .. 2026-05-12, is deliberately the tighter,
# reproducible-from-this-repo list: gauged against the actual clip polygon
# rather than an unrecorded wider box. If exact parity with the operator's
# original ~1400-item list matters more than this narrower, polygon-exact
# discovery, paste that list here instead (one ATL13_*.h5 per line).
